title: NATO launches STARLIFT to boost military satellite deployment
html: NATO announced the STARLIFT multinational space initiative at the NATO EDGE 26 conference in Türkiye on November 17, with 10 allies and South Korea jointly funding reserved commercial rocket-launch slots to make military satellite deployment faster and more...
summary: NATO announced the STARLIFT multinational space initiative at the NATO EDGE 26 conference in Türkiye on November 17, with 10 allies and South Korea jointly funding reserved commercial rocket-launch slots to make military satellite deployment faster and more resilient.
